information:
A fundraising competition for SSA-B's Scholastican Involvement and Community Outreach Program (SICOP) various projects and activities. 70% of the collected registration fees will fund SSA's SICOP Medical Mission, and future activities.


Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, PCA, and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage, or loss resulting from your participation of this event.
Please read the **[WCA rules and regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**.
Please check the **Competitor Guide and Updates** tab regarding changes.
Please check **Events and Schedules** tabs for more information.
